name: Arkansas
agency: Arkansas DHS county office (Division of County Operations)

period.description: Your spend-down covers three calendar months, and you must re-enroll every three months.

submission.description: Give your medical bills to your DHS county office so they can be subtracted from your extra income for the three-month period.

notes: Your three-month spend-down period can start in one of the three months before you applied.
Spend-down coverage is listed as a limited benefit; ask your county office what it covers.
Remember to re-enroll every three months to keep coverage.
